# SmartZim

SmartZim is a Zimbabwe-focused learning and exam-prep platform for students, teachers, and parents. It covers ZIMSEC and Cambridge curricula and offers AI tutoring, past papers, notes, assignments, mock exams, and school administration tools.

## Public pages (indexable)

- / — Landing / home page
- /ministry — Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education (MoPSE) public announcements
- /privacy — Privacy policy
- /terms — Terms of service

## Sitemap

https://smartzim.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Utility pages (not for indexing)

These pages require user action or authentication and are marked `noindex, nofollow`. They are also disallowed in robots.txt — do not index them:

- /login — Sign in
- /register — Create an account
- /pending — Account pending approval
- /rejected — Registration not approved

## Teacher profiles

Public teacher profile pages (/teachers/:userId) exist but are not currently intended for indexing: they are rendered client-side and do not yet emit unique canonical HTML or per-profile metadata. Do not index them until per-profile canonical HTML is available.

## Preferred crawl guidance

Index only the public pages listed under "Public pages (indexable)" above. Authenticated app pages (/app/*) require a login and should not be indexed.
